title: Power outage and environmental justice in Winter Storm Uri: an analytical workflow based on nighttime light remote sensing
datasets: NASA Black Marble daily nighttime lights

dataset_roles.dataset: NASA Black Marble daily nighttime lights

idea.research_question: How can satellite-observed nighttime-light outages and population context reveal unequal exposure to extreme-weather power disruptions?
idea.hypothesis: The joint signal should explain variation that cannot be identified from any single required dataset alone.
idea.mechanism: Align every required role, construct role-specific features, test interactions, and compare against single-role ablations.
idea.analytical_approach: Multisource spatial-temporal modelling with interaction, robustness and ablation analysis
idea.expected_contribution: A benchmark task grounded in an independently screened multidataset seed paper.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject if any required role is absent, background-only, or not operationally used in the same research instance.
